{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any QA orders are in 'completed' status
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'QA orders that are completed: {len(qa_completed)}')

# Check if any QA orders have converted == 1
qa_converted = qa_completed[qa_completed['converted'] == 1]
print(f'QA orders that are completed AND converted: {len(qa_converted)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f'Number of -1 in customer_age: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')"}
